info.title: Kavosh One Foundation API
info.description: Tested backend foundation and human identity APIs, not a complete academy/accounting platform. Bots use scoped bearer credentials; verified humans use host-only HttpOnly sessions plus X-Academy-Id, with membership and current role grants checked server-side. Cookie-authenticated mutations require exact APP_ORIGIN. Explicit denial wins. All sensitive responses are no-store.

botBearer.description: Expiring kvo_ opaque credential. Store securely and send in Authorization; never use query parameters.

humanSession.name: __Secure-kavosh.session_token
humanSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly signed cookie set by login/MFA, never read or stored by frontend JavaScript. Local HTTP development uses kavosh.session_token.

academySelection.name: X-Academy-Id
academySelection.description: Academy UUID; selecting it does not grant membership or permission.

idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency.description: Reuse for retries of this exact operation. Changed payload returns 409. Permission is rechecked on replay.

after.name: after
after.description: Pass nextCursor from the preceding result.

error.description: Error: 400 invalid input/reference, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden, 409 idempotency conflict, 413 oversized body, 415 wrong content type, 429 rate limit or 503 unavailable. Body contains error.code and error.requestId; X-Request-Id is also returned. No stack traces, tokens or database details are exposed.

list.description: JSON object with data array and nextCursor (UUID or null). All records are permission-filtered.

post.summary: accept invitation
post.description: Accept an original private invitation with a current email/phone-verified signed session and mandatory/optional enabled MFA completed. The exact approved person,school,source and live expiry/revocation are rechecked under the original native lock order. After a verified email change,an immutable private binding preserves that token only for the SAME auth identity,not another future holder of the old email. Both native identity/source checks use the same pinned predicate;no new account signup through an already-bound token. No role,recipient or invitation rewrite,activation before acceptance,legal identity verification or waiver/admission claim. School/person unavailability and sole-master non-transferability remain enforced.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match configured APP_ORIGIN.

200.description: Completed; may require email/phone/MFA next. Session tokens are never returned in JSON.

202.description: Recovery/resend accepted without disclosing account existence.

post.summary: change password
post.description: Authentication gateway allowlist. Strict UTF-8 JSON, 16 KiB maximum and a total 10-second body-read deadline. Interrupted or timed-out bodies return 408; oversized bodies return 413. Phone setup requires a fresh email-verified session; academy access also requires phone verification. Master MFA is mandatory on new devices; enabling/disabling MFA or changing password revokes sessions. Reset does not disable MFA. Session revocation uses sessionId, never raw token. See repository auth flow for sequencing.

get.summary: email change
get.description: Private signed-session email replacement,not an administrative identity transfer. Fresh completed email/phone/MFA plus the real current password start a request(maximum3/hour). An8-digit code goes only to the current verified inbox;authorize consumes it once and sends a separate8-digit code only to the server-bound new inbox. Both proofs are keyed digests,owned by the same user/session/request/source/target. Five wrong guesses exhaust each stage;15-minute total lifetime and at most5minutes for new-inbox proof. Encrypted queued mail expires no later than the actual proof. Confirm requires that new-inbox code and atomically changes verified login email,revokes all sessions/trusted-device/reset proofs and records security audit. Existing academy/master identity,roles,legal/historical registration and signed documents are not rewritten. Old addresses have a16-minute reuse cooldown so earlier address-bound verification links expire before reassignment. Status/cancel exposes no code/hash/source;cancel needs current signed session but not freshness. Eligible still-pending invitations are privately pinned to this SAME verified account after the change;original recipient,role assignments,expiry,revocation and sole-master policy are not rewritten. Sign in with the new email,then accept the original private token. Proof/mutation steps fail closed503 until the matching native schema is installed;current status/cancellation remain available. No automatic sign-in or MFA weakening,no live-provider guarantee. Loss of BOTH inbox access or recovery factors is not resolved by this endpoint.

get.summary: phone change
get.description: Private signed-session phone recovery. Fresh completed email/phone/MFA sign-in and the real current password start a request (maximum3/hour);an8-digit code is sent only to the current verified email,never returned or stored plaintext. Pending proof expires15minutes,five wrong email guesses exhaust it,and authorization is single-use and bound to the same session/request/target. Authorized permission lasts at most5minutes and still requires the existing new-phone SMS OTP flow. No phone changes before that verification. Completion atomically revokes sessions/trusted-device proofs and records security audit;master identity and mandatory MFA never transfer or weaken. Cancellation removes only the owned request;status contains no approval code/hash/password/source snapshot. No live delivery guarantee.

get.summary: Process liveness (does not imply database readiness)

Authenticated private video bytes,not a bearer URL. Current file/domain rights,exact native decoded-video/copy proof,explicit reviewed video-serving policy and separate reader credentials required on EACH range/HEAD. DB transaction is committed and released before storage IO. Single-range206,unsatisfied416,If-Range and HEAD supported;server pins source ETag internally. No-store,strict video MIME,CORP same-origin;32transfers/process and4/actor,bounded backpressure,cancellation and10minute whole-transfer budget. Existing bytes already received cannot be revoked mid-view;next request rechecks rights. No live provider or browser-codec playback certification.

parameters.name: academyId
parameters.description: Non-secret school selector,NOT authorization;credential school and current rights are still checked.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Single bytes range only;ignored on HEAD.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Strong measured-content ETag;nonmatching/weak/date values select full response.

get.description: Permission-aware academy/backend API. Approval-required actions return pending proposals for non-masters; ordinary catalogue edits apply within granted scope using optimistic versions. Unmentioned patch fields retain their values. Course modules, when supplied, replace the complete ordered outline; earlier revisions are preserved. No UI or live-provider verification is implied. post.summary: Receive a configured, raw-byte-authenticated BoldSign event into the isolated durable inbox; never admission clearance
post.description: Provider-only authentication, not a human session or bot token. Off until operator configuration, registered school/region/environment/client identity and isolated ingest database role are verified. HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + dot + original bytes; current/previous endpoint-specific secret and fixed 300-second freshness window. A strict Verification probe may be unsigned but performs no database call. New operator registrations retain only document events already bound to a signing transport observation for the exact school and connection; unrelated or early unbound events are acknowledged without inbox/outbox persistence. Early-event completion requires independent provider reconciliation after the transport observation, not reliance on callback retention. All authenticated attempts still consume the bounded connection budget. Retained identical event IDs deduplicate; differing authenticated bytes retain the original and record one critical conflict per digest. Private signer content is not retained. No live provider verification or enrolment eligibility is implied.

parameters.name: X-BoldSign-Signature
parameters.description: Required for every data event. Provider HMAC header; only the strict no-data Verification probe is exempt.

parameters.name: X-BoldSign-Event
parameters.description: When present must match the signed eventType; Verification enables only the strict unsigned probe.

schema.description: Original UTF-8 JSON bytes, at most 1 MiB. Data events require a valid X-BoldSign-Signature and configured environment/client identity. Only an X-BoldSign-Event: Verification probe with no data is unsigned and side-effect free. Document objects require documentId. Unknown provider fields are discarded, not retained.

200.description: Received, duplicate, conflict recorded, unbound event ignored, or side-effect-free verification probe. No source details or admission status returned.

401.description: Missing, stale or invalid provider signature

408.description: Body read cancelled or deadline exceeded

429.description: Shared database per-connection rate budget exhausted

503.description: Disabled/unconfigured, changed registry, unsafe database role or unavailable persistence; no accepted partial record

post.summary: Receive signed payment references into a school/account-bound isolated durable inbox; never mark an invoice paid
post.description: Disabled by default. Official Stripe SDK authenticates original bytes with endpoint-specific current/previous secrets and a fixed 300-second past/future bound. Operator registry pins school,own account,mode and snapshot API version. No Connect/thin event, browser success page, human session, bot token or supplied academy metadata provides payment authority. Only minimal event/object references and original-body digest retained; no card/customer/metadata or money fields. Duplicate event IDs deduplicate; conflicting authenticated content preserves original and records a critical alert. Multiple event IDs for the same object are evidence only,not separate receipts; event timestamps are not used to order financial state. No live provider, checkout creation, payment reconciliation, receipt, charge, refund or financial posting is verified or performed. Subscribe only to these event types: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, checkout.session.async_payment_failed, checkout.session.expired, payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, payment_intent.canceled, charge.refunded, refund.created, refund.updated, refund.failed, charge.dispute.created, charge.dispute.updated, charge.dispute.closed, payout.paid, payout.failed, payout.canceled.

schema.description: Original UTF-8 snapshot JSON bytes, at most 1 MiB. Required Stripe-Signature authenticates the configured account-level endpoint. Unknown provider data is discarded; no payment or ledger status is changed.
